states.name: lineSoftSubtle
states.description: Panel and dock frames at rest.

states.name: line
states.description: Outlines at rest, and every divider inside a row.

states.name: item
states.description: A highlighted or selected row's fill.

states.name: controlBorder
states.description: A highlighted or selected outline, and a focused field's border.

states.name: textMeta
states.description: Meta text at rest (dates, projects, placeholders, hints). The terminal theme's white (ANSI 7).

states.name: textMetaHighlighted
states.description: Meta text on a highlighted row in a focused area. The one step between the terminal's white and foreground.

states.name: textBody
states.description: Body text at rest. The terminal theme's foreground.

states.name: textSelected
states.description:
Text on a highlighted or selected item. Bold on top of it means selected, in a lasting-selection list only.
The terminal theme's bright white (ANSI 15).

states.name: accent
states.description: The one gold: titles, project headers and marks.

states.name: brassActive
states.description: "On", for toggles only (the action bar's inner glow).

states.name: warn
states.description: A warning: a missing file's icon, in every state.
